prompt: What gear dominates fishing in Taal Lake, and how did its catch per unit effort change?
response: Gill net is the most dominant gear in Taal Lake, accounting for approximately 53% of the total gear used (Mutia et al., 2018). The catch per unit effort (CPUE) for this gear declined from 11 kg/day in 1997 to 4 kg/day in 2011 (Mutia et al., 2018).
